title: Position Proposer I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 115. The model's own job is narrow -- given this week's topic brief, the corpus, and the voice profile, write up to 3 candidate positions that differ on a declared distinctness_axis. Assembling the OptionCard (contracts/option-card.schema.json) -- lettering the options, setting autonomy_level/risk_tier from policies/autonomy-matrix.yaml, and looking up whether a chosen position already exists for function 43 to read -- is orchestrator code (services/orchestrator/orchestrator/dispatch.py's propose_founder_position_handler calling services/options_inbox/cards.py's build_card), not this model's job. That split mirrors Fn 116's own compose_options_handler.

proof_points.description: This week's {claim, source} proof points, per prompt.md's own 'never invent a number' rule.

corpus_atoms.description: Fn 113's own mined atoms -- the only source an evidenced (non-novel) stance may cite.

voice_profile.description: Fn 114's latest published profile, for exemplar phrasing -- null if none has published yet.

stance.description: A one-line stance in the leader's voice, per prompt.md task step -- never paraphrased into consultant-speak.

distinctness_axis.description: e.g. contrarian vs consensus, economics vs technical, CFO-facing vs IT-facing -- never three phrasings of one stance.

novel_stance.description: True when nothing in the corpus/positions ledger supports this stance -- mandatory label, not optional, per prompt.md.

evidence_atom_ids.description: corpus_atoms[*].atom_id this position cites -- empty when novel_stance is true.

recommended.description: Index into positions[] -- prompt.md: 'your rationale must say why this stance now, for this audience.'
